summary: Show four places, Home, Money, To-do and Records, with an Add button in the middle, as the app's whole structure.
requirement_text: Thapal becomes four places and one button: Home, Money, To-do and Records, with Add in the middle.
baseline_known_limits: Shell is Today/Spaces/Smart Add/Review/More (AppShell.tsx); no Money, To-do or Records places

summary: The owner can see and do every action in every owned workspace; professionals see only what is granted, for as long as granted.
requirement_text: Rule zero: you control everything. You can see and do every action in every workspace you own. Thapal and the professionals you invite prepare and propose; you approve, change or undo. Professionals see only what you grant, for as long as you grant it.
baseline_known_limits: Entity grants have no expiry; accountant review grants staged; workspaces are labels, not boundaries

summary: Only uncertain items go to To-do; confident items post straight to the one ledger that every place and professional view reads.
requirement_text: Only uncertain items reach To-do; everything else flows straight to the ledger, and every place and professional workspace reads that same ledger.
baseline_known_limits: Statement Desk auto-posts confident lines; receipts/documents still need a confirm; doubts wait in Statement Desk, not To-do

summary: An individual's only job is to scan, upload or forward documents; Thapal does everything after that.
requirement_text: As an individual you have one job: scan, upload or forward. Everything after that is Thapal's job.
baseline_known_limits: Scan and upload exist; no forward-by-email intake; most items still need user confirmation

summary: Each receipt, one or fifty at once, is read, tied to the paying card, category and entity, GST-checked, linked to its statement row and posted.
requirement_text: You do: Snap or upload a receipt, one or fifty at a time | Thapal does: Reads it; finds the card or account that paid, the category, and the person, company or trust it belongs to; checks GST; links it to the statement row; posts it
baseline_known_limits: Batch is a one-by-one queue; each receipt needs a confirm; no automatic GST validity check or auto-post

summary: A bank or card statement, uploaded or collected by upload request, is read row by row, matched, balance-checked and each item posted once.
requirement_text: You do: Upload or forward a bank or card statement, or let an upload request collect it | Thapal does: Reads every row; matches transfers, card bills and receipts; checks the balance; posts each item once
baseline_known_limits: Atomic upload undo is staged SQL; no automatic bank-alert or email fetch
approval: Awaiting KK review; status provisional pending strict re-check

summary: Any other document (policy, deed, loan letter, CAS, past return, contractor bill) is recognised and updates its register, reminders, books and net worth.

baseline_known_limits: Routes entity, FY, asset, property, lease, GST, loan, tax, investment docs; user confirms each; no contractor-bill register

summary: Thapal does bookkeeping, reconciliation, statements, month close, tax workings, compliance calendar, reports and evidence packs with no user work.
requirement_text: You do: Nothing else | Thapal does: Bookkeeping, reconciliation, statements, month close, tax workings, compliance calendar, reports and evidence packs
baseline_known_limits: Each piece exists but is user-driven (close, reports, tax drafts); not automatic end to end

summary: Only new situations, kept approvals and legally human steps reach To-do, each one tap with a suggested answer; Dr/Cr hidden unless Accountant view.
requirement_text: Only three things can still reach you, each as one tap in To-do with the answer already suggested: a genuinely new situation, such as a first payment to someone new; approvals you chose to keep, such as the month lock or a filing; and steps the law or your bank keeps human, such as an OTP on a government portal or approving a payment in your bank. Debits, credits and journals stay out of your sight unless you switch on Accountant view.
baseline_known_limits: Inbox lists many item types with an action, not a suggested answer; no Accountant view switch

summary: Every statement, bill, receipt or invoice enters only through Add; there is no second upload place.
requirement_text: One way in. Every statement, bill, receipt or invoice arrives through Add. There is no second upload place.
baseline_known_limits: Vault routes to Smart Add, but statements, gst-check, booking import, asset check and company access keep own file pickers

A secondary article is never treated as the official format. The same applies to GST, TDS and TCS, trusts and 80G, Companies Act and MCA filings, payroll statutory data, Malaysian reporting (only for entities with that profile, Decision 49) and the DPDP privacy duties as each phase begins.
